messages: alex: FYI I opened a PR for sealed-site installer docs — adds KMS/HSM examples, airgap packaging notes, and fixes a bunch of broken anchors. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/847 :eyes: maria: Nice, linking that now. Quick scan: looks like the PKCS#11 section is missing an example for slot/slot-id mapping. We should show both `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` and how to map vendor slot numbers to middleware slots. sam: I can draft a short snippet for SoftHSM and a Thales example. Which one do we prefer as the primary example? SoftHSM is easier to reproduce in CI. tina: ops preference: generic PKCS#11 code in the main doc + vendor-specific appendix (Thales/Entrust/Utimaco). Also add a short note about jumbo-frames/MTU 9000 causing packet fragmentation for some HSM VM paths. ben: Also spotted a broken anchor: the network-flow diagram anchor changed from `#network-flow` to `#sealedsite-network-flow` in a prior rename, so the traffic matrix table link 404s. PR needs that anchor fix and maybe a redirect note. dev-doc-bot: Lint results for PR #847: anchors_missing: 2, broken_links: 1, required_frontmatter: OK, table_of_contents: missing. Please address. alex: Thanks all. I'll add the anchor fix and TOC. Sam — please add SoftHSM snippet; Tina can you add the MTU note and ops checklist item? Maria — can you confirm exact pkcs11 command output we should show? maria: Example output we use for docs: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so -L` and `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --list-slots`. Show mapping like: ``` # list slots Slot 0: Token label: SoftHSM2 token Slot 1: Token label: TestToken # middleware maps Slot 0 -> slot 1 (vendor numbering vs library numbering) ``` sam: Draft snippet pushed to branch alex/sealedsite-docs-snippet. SoftHSM quick install for local testing: ``` # install on ubuntu sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y softhsm2 softhsm2-util --init-token --free --label TestToken --pin 1234 --so-pin 5678 ``` sam: Also added `pkcs11-tool` examples for listing objects and generating a key: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --keypairgen --id 01 --key-type RSA:2048` ops-eng: For airgap bundles, add explicit steps to include vendor libs and kernel modules in the release tarball. Example snippet for packager: ``` # copy vendor hsm driver and pkcs11 library into offline bundle mkdir -p offline-bundle/vendor/hsm cp /opt/vendor/hsm/libvendorpkcs11.so offline-bundle/vendor/hsm/ cp /opt/vendor/hsm/driver.ko offline-bundle/vendor/hsm/ # tar up with checksum tar czf redwood-sealedsite-archive.tar.gz offline-bundle && sha256sum redwood-sealedsite-archive.tar.gz > sha256.txt ``` ops-eng: And note: kernel module must be compiled for target kernel ABI or included as DKMS recipe — call this out in appendix. maria: Suggest we also include a tiny systemd unit for kms-proxy that people can copy. Helps for onprem quickstarts. alex: Good call. Use this minimal example in docs: ``` [Unit] Description=KMS Proxy After=network.target [Service] Type=simple ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml Restart=on-failure LimitNOFILE=65536 [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target ``` alex: I'll patch the PR with that unit and the anchor fix. Ben — can you paste the broken-link stackline? ben: Sure — failing link in docs: `docs/sealedsite/network.md:lnk-> #network-flow` -> 404. Change to `#sealedsite-network-flow` or add alias anchor. I can add a tiny redirect snippet (``) in network.md to preserve old links. tina: Also add a troubleshooting bullet: `If HSM init fails with ECONNRESET, try lowering MTU on the host interface to 1500 and ensure no tunnel encapsulation is doubling headers.` dev-doc-bot: Reminder: update table_of_contents to include "HSM appendix" and "Airgap packaging" sections. alex: Action items: sam -> add SoftHSM + pkcs11 examples (in branch), tina -> add MTU/troubleshooting and ops checklist, ben -> add anchor alias, maria -> confirm pkcs11 outputs and vendor mapping blurb, alex -> update PR with systemd unit, TOC, and bundle packaging snippet. I'll re-run lint afterwards. ETA EOD tomorrow? :calendar: sam: ETA EOD today for the SoftHSM snippet, will push shortly. :white_check_mark: ben: I'll open tiny PR for anchor alias and link tests. maria: I'll validate the pkcs11 outputs against our test token and post back if any edits needed. ops-eng: I'll review the airgap packaging snippet and add a DKMS note. alex: Thanks — ping here when PR updated and we'll merge after a quick docs + ops signoff. :rocket:
